sources.snippet: This repository contains the reference inference code for FLUX 3 Image Klein, the 5.6B open weights image model from Black Forest Labs: text-to-image, editing with up to 10 reference images, and layout control with bounding boxes, through one model. It ships with a prompt upsampler; do not use the model without it.

sources.snippet: AI image workflows often require different models for text-to-image generation, reference-based editing, and multi-image composition. Switching between models can make the workflow more complicated, especially when you need precise control over object placement, consistent subjects, or detailed edits. sources.title: flux-3-image-klein Model by Black-forest-labs | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: FLUX 3 Image Klein is an open-weights model family developed by Black Forest Labs for text-to-image generation and image editing. It takes a text prompt and up to 10 reference images and returns one image, supporting single-reference edits, multi-reference compositions, and prompt-based bounding-box layout control.
